summary: New Scaleway Professional customers get a €100 free-credit voucher (emailed within 24 hours of account creation) usable across Scaleway cloud services including Generative APIs. Requires a valid payment method; anyone ever invoiced by Scaleway (even €0) is ineligible.
claim_steps: Create a new Professional account at Scaleway with a valid payment method.
A €100 voucher code is emailed within 24 hours; redeem it to start the trial.
Eligibility: never previously invoiced by Scaleway (a €0 invoice counts).

social_proof.title: Compare Scaleway vs DigitalOcean
social_proof.text: Create a Professional account and get started with €100 free credit. ... your free trial will start when you redeem the voucher code sent to you by email within 24 hours.
